styleSuffix: STYLE (repeat verbatim across the set): editorial still-life photograph in one paper-white studio; north-window softbox from camera-left, a low warm rim light from behind-right; palette locked to paper #F4F1EA, ink #1C1B19, clay #B8865B, smoke #6F6A63, brass #C9A24A; matte bisque ceramic, smoked glass, worn brass, raw linen, grey stone; 85mm lens, f/4, shallow but honest depth; subtle 35mm film grain, slightly lifted blacks, no vignette baked in; off-center framing with generous negative space; imperfect surfaces, fingerprints and dust allowed. Absolutely no text, no logos, no people, no faces, no hands, no plastic or waxy sheen, no perfect symmetry, no oversaturation, no fake bokeh.

items.prompt: Wide studio table in paper-white light. A single matte bisque ceramic incense vessel, tall and slightly tapered, stands off-center right with a thin thread of smoke rising and bending in still air; a worn brass lid rests beside it. Background falls to soft smoke-grey. Ample empty space on the left third for a headline.
Close three-quarter view of the tall bisque vessel on grey stone, morning light raking across its surface showing throwing lines.

Thread of smoke crossing a shaft of window light, the vessel out of focus behind it.
Three unglazed ceramic test tiles in cream, clay and smoke tones laid in a loose row on stone.
